title: The Sierra Nevadas are a must trip and this company is the one to take you.
text: The beautiful mountains of course. Wandering around the 3 villages was so interesting. The weaving demonstration was very interesting. The snack laid out with fantastic hams, other meats, and cheese and wine was a welcome treat. And Sow was fabulous. He answered all our questions. So knowledgeable, friendly, funny, and totally approachable. Manuel is an excellent driver. We felt very safe motoring  along the winding  roads with the sheer drops.  Excellent value for the price.
author: Ingrid_F

title: Spectacular Day-trip to Las...
text:
Spectacular Day-trip to Las Alpujarras from Granada
The minivan was perfect for transporting 6 of us up to the slope of the Sierra Nevada.
Our tour guide/driver, Michael, is outstanding. He is an excellent driver and a fantastic guide, knowledgeable and friendly. The trip was relaxing and enjoyable. I didnt expect this trip to include tapa and lunch, so they were both nice surprises. The jamon, cheeses and local wine were lovely! I like the soup at the restaurant a lot. title: My son and I enjoyed exploring...
text: My son and I enjoyed exploring several lovely villages. Our driver and guide were exceptional. Antonio is a real historian so we learned a lot about the area which enhanced our appreciation. We liked the flexibility of some time on our own, checking in with us about our needs, and tips where the best place was to buy a ham, etc. Overall it was a smooth and interesting experience from beginning to end, including purchasing the tour online, contacting the local agent, and being picked up where we were staying in Granada.
author: Phyllis S
